title: 第7章 秀雁斗王妈妈完胜！
slug: 侯府商女全本免费-侯府商女最新章节列表
content_zh:
春嵋之前议亲的时候，这王妈妈看中了春嵋在四姑娘跟前的得脸，竟然想攀高枝，这不是将春嵋给得罪了。
其他人知道这里面的道道的，都不说话，讥讽的听着，这婆子演戏能演到什么时候？
屋子里的王妈妈杀猪般的声音还哭哭啼啼的，“表姑娘啊，你快醒醒啊，你要是有个三长两短的，我老婆子怎么活啊？表姑娘你醒醒啊，你要是不醒我老婆子就跟着去了啊！”
这王妈妈的声音一声高过一声，就似那浪花一浪高过一浪似的，就连拍在了岩石上都不能阻挡！
这会子在清花阁小厨房熬药的秀雁感觉不对，王妈妈这人最懒惰，昨晚找了那么久都没有影子，这会子怎么一个不留神就钻到姑娘跟前去了，不行得赶快过去，看着老婆子要做什么。
秀雁赶快擦擦手，然后将熬药的事情交给青杏，急匆匆的往主屋这边走来。
清花阁本来是个落寞的院子，后来慧姐住进来之后，大夫人要显出自己关爱慧姐，才弄个小厨房，其实就在清花阁最边上，离着主屋得走上一炷香的时间才能到。
秀雁是真的非常担心，姑娘昨晚上不知道怎么了就摔了头，还跌倒了荷花池里面，幸好这数九寒天的荷花池都冻上了，否则姑娘真的没命了。
即使这样，姑娘不仅头摔破了，浑身摔得泥浆浆的，要不是二房的代菡姑娘正好瞧见了，叫起了大家，恐怕这会子真的出事了。
秀雁是跟着慧姐到了卢家的人，不过眼下很多人都被大夫人给寻了由头赶走了，内宅只剩下她和青杏了，外院也只剩下了她的二哥成安。
幸好昨个她让青杏通知二哥及时，否则请不来杜太医，姑娘想捡回一条命也是难办的。
“表姑娘你醒醒啊……”王妈妈的大嗓门又开始了，秀雁急三火四的顺着抄手游廊朝着屋子里面走去。
这会子浑身都处于疼痛的叶贝儿难过异常，被这遇见狼一般的嚎叫声音给弄得十分难受，不知道这是谁，是哪个极品的大妈哎，这吓死人的嚎叫声，这是号谁呢这么难听？谁是表姑娘，难道自己被救了？
只是这声音是太难听了，这位大婶您这是嚎谁呢？
难道说这是在艾米或者佳妮的亲族家里？那就说自己还活着？那她们两个呢？那些混蛋是不是都干掉了？很快头一阵剧烈的疼痛，很多画面铺天盖地的闪来，稍微意识有些清醒的慧姐又昏了过去……
王妈妈哪里知道这些，还在那里一个劲的干嚎，不过时间久了，嗓子有些难过，想使唤个小丫鬟倒杯茶，这才发现屋子里面一个人没有。
那些卢家给搭配的丫鬟本来都懒得要命，表姑娘平时也不会约束，这些俗气的事情都是秀雁打理的，不过秀雁也就是个大丫头，又是从叶家带来伺候的，主子都不管，奴婢管奴婢自然威严不够，所以很难管理。
那些懒东西们昨个折腾了一夜，这会子不知道哪里躲着休息呢！
王妈妈还骂骂唧唧的道：“一个个不听话偷懒的小蹄子们，不要被我抓到了，否则有你们好看的。”
要不是想着今个外面那么多奴婢都过来看热闹，她老婆子至于这么费力的演戏吗？

王妈妈还用余光瞥了瞥躺在床上依旧不动的表姑娘叶沁慧，表情充满了不屑，再仔细看看还包含了不少的鄙视，对就是鄙视！
说起来，这个表姑娘真是不省事，明明银子多得很，偏偏视金钱如粪土，最喜欢那些个穷掉了牙的酸诗，见天的跟着大少爷的后面风啊云啊，山啊水啊的，有好房子不住，有好吃的不吃，有好穿好戴嫌俗气。
表姑娘每日除了哭哭啼啼，其他什么事情不做，还任性的不得了，铺子不要，庄子不管，宅子不要，这清花阁也不打理，生怕沾染了人间俗气。
王妈妈很难理解这表姑娘到底想要作什么？每日看见个风啊落叶啊哭哭啼啼的，这不是有病么？你就是在相当仙女，你不是还没成仙吗？那不是还和凡人一样吃饭睡觉如厕吗？哪里就清高了？

content_en:
When Chunmei was discussing marriage, Mrs. Wang took a fancy to Chunmei's appearance in front of the fourth girl, and even wanted to climb a high branch. This was not to offend Chunmei.
The others knew what was going on here, so they didn't say anything and listened sarcastically. How long can this woman act?
In the room, Mrs. Wang's voice was like a butchering pig, and she was still crying, "Cousin, wake up quickly. If you have a bad boy, how will my old lady live? Cousin, wake up, if you don't wake up, my old lady will follow you!"
Mother Wang's voice was getting louder every time, just like the waves were getting higher and higher, even hitting the rocks couldn't stop her!
Xiuyan, who was brewing medicine in the small kitchen of Qinghua Pavilion, felt something was wrong. Mother Wang was the laziest. She had been looking for her for so long last night but there was no sign of her. Why did she sneak in in front of the girl without paying attention? She had to hurry over and see what the old woman was going to do.
Xiuyan quickly wiped her hands, then handed over the preparation of the medicine to Qingxing, and hurriedly walked towards the main house.
Qinghua Pavilion was originally a lonely courtyard. Later, after Sister Hui moved in, the eldest lady wanted to show that she cared for Sister Hui, so she built a small kitchen. In fact, it was at the very edge of Qinghua Pavilion, and it took a stick of incense to walk to get there.
Xiu Yan was really worried. The girl didn't know what happened last night, so she fell on her head and fell into the lotus pond. Fortunately, the lotus pond was frozen in these nine cold days, otherwise the girl would really have died.
Even so, the girl not only broke her head, but also was covered in mud. If the girl Daihan from the second room hadn't happened to see her and call everyone, I'm afraid something would have really happened.
Xiuyan was the one who followed Sister Hui to the Lu family, but now many people were driven away by the eldest lady. She and Qingxing were the only ones left in the inner house, and her second brother Chengan was the only one left in the outer courtyard.
Fortunately, she asked Qingxing to notify her second brother in time yesterday, otherwise she would not be able to invite Doctor Du, and it would be difficult for the girl to save her life.
"Cousin, please wake up..." Mother Wang's loud voice started again, and Xiuyan hurriedly walked along the corridor towards the house.
Ye Beier, who was in pain all over her body, was extremely sad. She was very uncomfortable with the howling sound like a wolf. She didn't know who this was, which top-notch aunt she was. Who was this frightening howling sound? It was so ugly? Who is the cousin? Has she been rescued?
It's just that the sound is too unpleasant. Who are you yelling at, auntie?
Could it be that this is at the home of Amy or Jiani’s relatives? Then you say you are still alive? What about the two of them? Have all those bastards been killed? Soon there was a sharp pain for the first time, and many images flashed across the sky. Sister Hui, who was slightly conscious, fainted again...
How did Mrs. Wang know this? She kept howling there. However, after a long time, her throat became a little sad. She wanted to ask the little maid to pour a cup of tea, but then she realized that there was no one in the room.
The maids matched by the Lu family were too lazy to begin with, and the cousin would not restrain them at ordinary times. Xiuyan took care of these tacky things, but Xiuyan was just a big girl, and she was brought from the Ye family to serve. The master didn't care, and the slaves naturally didn't have enough dignity to control the slaves, so it was difficult to manage them.
Those lazy guys worked hard all night, and now they don’t know where to hide and rest!
Mother Wang also scolded and said: "You disobedient and lazy little hooves, don't let me catch you, otherwise you will be in trouble."
If she hadn't thought about the fact that so many slaves outside were coming to watch the fun, would the old lady have put so much effort into acting?
Mother Wang also glanced at her cousin Ye Qinhui, who was still lying on the bed, with her peripheral vision. Her expression was full of disdain. If you look closely, it also contained a lot of contempt. Yes, it was contempt!
Speaking of which, this cousin girl is really inconvenient. She is obviously silver.He has a lot of children, but he regards money as dirt. He likes the sour poems written by poor people the most. He follows the eldest young master to see the wind, clouds, mountains and rivers. He doesn’t live in a good house, eats delicious food, and thinks it’s tacky even if he wears good clothes.
Cousin girl does nothing but cry every day, and she is extremely willful. She doesn't want the shop, Zhuangzi doesn't care, the house doesn't want it, and she doesn't take care of the Qinghua Pavilion, for fear of being contaminated by the tackiness of the world.
It's hard for Mrs. Wang to understand what this cousin wants to do? If you see the wind, fallen leaves, or cries every day, isn't this a disease? You are acting like a fairy, haven't you yet become a fairy? Wouldn’t that mean you still eat, sleep and use the toilet like ordinary people? Where can I be arrogant?
